source.name: PR Newswire (Scotiabank / MLSE)
source.quote: Scotiabank and Maple Leafs Sports and Entertainment (MLSE) announced an expanded sponsorship and philanthropic partnership which will see the home of the Toronto Maple Leafs and Toronto Raptors transformed into the Scotiabank Arena

note: Arena naming rights: Scotiabank Arena. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2017-08-29.
